additional_analytical_decisions: Construct a joint cash-funding and contractual-covenant feasibility model. Borrowing finances distributions while adding cash interest and can activate a previously inapplicable test. Optimize across the resulting regimes and distinguish an achievable amount from an open-boundary limit.
reference_method: Decimal economic model with separate derivation, valid alternative SQL and regime checks

controls.name: commitment_before_trigger
controls.rationale: The committed ceiling can bind while the covenant remains inapplicable.

controls.name: threshold_at_commitment
controls.rationale: Equality activates the covenant even at the final committed dollar.

controls.name: interest_cost
controls.rationale: Borrowing cost affects both funding and the fixed-charge denominator.

controls.name: working_capital
controls.rationale: Cash absorption changes funding without changing covenant EBITDA.

controls.name: earnings
controls.rationale: Covenant headroom and cash generation move together when earnings change.

controls.name: suppressed_and_lc_context
controls.rationale: Suppressed availability is not commitment. LC is already included in utilisation.

controls.name: monetary_scale
controls.rationale: Double monetary amounts while preserving ratios, decisions and endpoint closure.

controls.name: row_order
controls.rationale: Row order carries no financial meaning.

source_review: Primary source headings, definitions and factual values inspected. Independent human review remains pending.
model_exposure: No model trials. Published references are a contamination risk. Development tasks only.
execution: Baseline task resources and frozen scorer reused. Qualified GLM uses 3600 seconds and 24 turns. Native Sol uses 3600 seconds and has no equivalent turn cap.
